itemdespawntowhat.command.debug.scene.de: Basic conversion: 1 paper produces 1 prismarine shard.
Fail the height condition and retry, then move the source up 3 blocks: produce 1 shard.
Convert 1 paper and produce 1 prismarine shard after a 100-tick delay.
Set source age to one tick before platform lifespan: convert at natural expiry.
A stack of 16 paper: one submission, 16 groups, and 16 shards.
Two rules with different due ages: the earlier rule converts first.
A check-locked source and an unlimited-lifetime source: no conversions; both paper remain.
Reload after the delayed effect is queued: cancel the settlement and effects; produce nothing.
Empty-load baseline, 60 seconds by default.
Conversion load: 1,000 entities and 60 seconds by default; count and duration are configurable.
Continuous condition failure and retry: 1,000 entities and 60 seconds by default.
Non-converting paper baseline: 1,000 entities and 10 seconds by default; maximum 1,000 source entities.
Paper converts after 5 game seconds: 1,000 entities and 10 seconds by default; maximum 1,000 source entities.
itemdespawntowhat.command.debug.scene.he: Run /idtw debug examples for every functional and benchmark scenario and its expectations.
itemdespawntowhat.command.debug.scene.de: 12 paper, source cost 3: produce 4 prismarine shards.
10 paper, source cost 3: produce 3 prismarine shards and return 1 protected paper.
2 paper cannot pay source cost 3: produce nothing and return both paper.
Priority candidates: all 4 paper select first, producing 4 prismarine shards.
4 independent sources alternate candidates: 2 prismarine shards and 2 gold nuggets.
2 paper: each group produces 1 shard and 2 gold nuggets delayed by 40 ticks; total 2 shards and 4 nuggets.
4 paper with chance 0: pay source costs, produce nothing, and log 4 chance skips.
An all_of + any_of + inverted condition tree converts 1 paper into 1 prismarine shard.
4 paper and 4 emeralds, catalyst cost 1 per group: produce 4 prismarine shards.
4 paper and 2 emeralds: run only 2 groups, produce 2 shards and return 2 paper.
